definitionZh: 中风-dasharray CSS属性定义了SVG形状的中风画中使用的破折痕和缺口图案. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The stroke-dasharray CSS property defines a pattern of dashes and gaps used in the painting of the SVG shape's stroke. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
